findings.claim: Entra telemetry authentication and delivery are not verified
findings.evidence: Task 3 disables local auth and grants the web UAMI Monitoring Metrics Publisher; Task 10 supplies only APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING and AZURE_CLIENT_ID. The Code-Generation Contract marks entra-telemetry as owned by B06/B10 and runtime_status unverified, but its dependencies list only the App Insights setting and role assignment, without requiring the app SDK to present a UAMI token. Task 13 checks resource diagnostic-setting presence, not authenticated app telemetry. Microsoft Learn's Application Insights Entra-authentication guidance requires an explicit credential for SDK-based apps and documents APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_AUTHENTICATION_STRING=Authorization=AAD;ClientId=... for App Service autoinstrumentation.
findings.impact: If the B06/B10 image does not explicitly configure a UAMI-backed telemetry credential, ingestion is rejected because local auth is disabled. The current post-deployment checks can still pass, so the plan could report readiness while application telemetry is absent.
findings.artifact_section: Task 10: modules/web.bicep; Code-Generation Contract: Microsoft.Web/sites:app and entra-telemetry; Task 13: diagnostics readiness

suggested_fix.proposed_edit: Extend the app contract to require Entra telemetry configuration: either configure the .NET SDK with a UAMI-backed ManagedIdentityCredential and explicit uamiClientId, or set APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_AUTHENTICATION_STRING=Authorization=AAD;ClientId=<uamiClientId> when using App Service autoinstrumentation. Add a bounded post-deploy check for authenticated telemetry arrival, or keep telemetry explicitly pending until B06/B10 supplies that evidence. Keep local auth disabled.
